description: The most a notary may charge for a notarial act in each U.S. state and the District of Columbia, as written in the state's own statute or agency page, with the online-notarization fee, the travel-fee wording and links to the sources. Call with no state for a one-line list, or with a state for its full table. States the limit; it does not judge whether a specific charge was lawful. General information, not legal advice.

state.description: State name or two-letter code, e.g. TX (optional)

title: What a notary may charge, by state
